name: Serving The Church
overview: Scripture calls believers to serve the church joyfully and wholeheartedly, recognizing that our service honors the Lord rather than men (Colossians 3:23, Psalms 100:2). Christ has entrusted leaders with the responsibility to shepherd and care for His church, which He redeemed by His own blood (Acts 20:28). The diverse gifts given by Christ—apostles, prophets, evangelists, pastors, and teachers—equip the saints for ministry and build up the body of Christ (Ephesians 4:11-12). As opportunities arise, believers are urged to do good especially within the household of faith, emphasizing the importance of serving fellow believers with love and diligence (Galatians 6:10).
